sources.summary: If Jensen Huang was a tough taskmaster at Nvidia before, just imagine what he’s going to be like now! President Donald Trump has proclaimed Huang’s reinstatement, announced Monday morning, was vital to America’s “success and prosperity.” In other words, Huang may feel he’s untouchable. His only problem is that he now owes his job to Trump.... If Jensen Huang was a tough taskmaster at Nvidia before, just imagine what he’s going to be like...
